script: A tiny star called TRAPPIST-1 has seven Earth-sized planets. They are about 40 light-years away. All seven orbit closer to their star than Mercury does to the Sun. Their years last between one and a half and 19 Earth days. Several of them are in the zone where liquid water could exist. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
